The middle term of an arithmetic sequence is the average of its neighbors: x = (9 + 81)/2 = 45.

Solution A has an error: adding the equations gives 3^4 − 3^2 = 2d, not 2x, since x cancels out. So its answer of 36 is wrong (36 is actually the common difference).

Solution B correctly finds d = 36 and x = 9 + 36 = 45, which checks out, since 81 − 45 = 36.

WINNER: B
